raw_text: The Indian Navy has deployed P-8I Poseidon maritime patrol aircraft to track a Chinese People's Liberation Army Navy Type 055 guided-missile destroyer that transited the Strait of Malacca into the Indian Ocean on Sunday. Defence sources said the warship, identified as the Yan'an, was accompanied by a fleet replenishment vessel. The deployment is part of an expanding PLAN presence in the Indian Ocean Region that India is closely monitoring.
clean_text: Indian Navy P-8I tracking PLAN Type 055 destroyer Yan'an in Indian Ocean after Malacca transit. Accompanied by replenishment vessel. Part of expanding PLAN IOR presence.
